dog.description_text:
🐶 11 weeks old
🐾 Potential Hound/Dachshund Mix
💕 Short, adorable, and oh-so-lovable!
Tiny is the smaller pup with the solid-colored face, and his buddy Buddy is the one with white on his face!
This precious little guy is shy, quiet, and gentle. He's a bit more timid than Buddy and needs a little extra time to feel comfortable. But with patience, kindness, and lots of love, he'll have the chance to blossom into a wonderful companion! 🥰
Tiny loves spending time outdoors exploring, but he's also perfectly happy relaxing inside.
🐱 Good with cats
👧 Best suited for a home with older children
🐾 Loves outdoor adventures
❤️ Shy, sweet, and gentle
dog.name: Tiny
